description: Agent Control: submit a router or marketplace’s stated ranking and routing criteria and its described decision flow (each step with the factors it applies and what it does). The signed report says whether a buyer or seller can tell why one seller was chosen, names every factor the flow applies that the stated criteria do not disclose, classed as paid placement, self-preference, inventory pressure, margin or commission, or another factor, and each stated criterion the flow does not use. Verdict undisclosed_influence, criteria_mismatch or disclosed. POST /api/router-disclosure-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.

factor.description: A stated ranking or routing criterion.

buyer_told_why.description: The buyer is told why a seller was chosen.

seller_told_why.description: A seller is told why it was or was not chosen.

flow.description: The described decision flow, in order.

text.description: What the step does, as described.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
